archetypes.name: dyn-calibration-data
archetypes.rationale: Analyzer logic has several artifact precedence and dedupe rules.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the new difficulty calibration analyzer's run discovery, classification precedence, identity dedupe, and realized-tier formula. Check that gc-slimmed and malformed inputs degrade without entering matrix denominators incorrectly. Pay special attention to design versus code-review panel parsing and numeric round precedence. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
